title: Low-income housing; income tax credit.
bodyText: The low-income housing tax credit provided under section 235-110.8 shall be operative for this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§241-4.7]  Low-income housing; income tax credit.  The low-income housing tax credit provided under section 235-110.8 shall be operative for this chapter. [L 1992, c 145, §2]
